papers.title: PhaseLoRA：面向连续动作视觉语言动作策略的控制阶段条件化低秩适配
papers.titleEn: PhaseLoRA: Control-Regime-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation for Continuous-Action Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.summary: 用LoRA高效微调预训练VLA时，标准适配器在整个操作轨迹中施加时间静态更新，忽视了接近、接触过渡、抓取、搬运与放置等不同控制阶段的动力学差异。PhaseLoRA利用动作导出的精细控制倾向与边界事件强度两项弱监督描述符，在每个动作块预测步动态调制动作专家的LoRA左因子，在LIBERO四套件与真机桌面任务上持续优于静态LoRA。但其代理描述符不依赖力觉，强接触任务下仍有限制。
papers.summaryEn: Standard LoRA applies temporally static updates when fine-tuning pretrained VLAs, ignoring distinct control regimes such as approach, contact transition, grasp, transport, and placement. PhaseLoRA modulates the action expert’s LoRA left factor at every action-chunk step using two weakly supervised action-derived descriptors—fine-control tendency and boundary intensity—outperforming static LoRA across LIBERO and real tabletop tasks. Because descriptors rely solely on kinematics rather than force/tactile cues, force-dominated tasks remain a boundary.
papers.whySelected: NeurIPS 2026 Oral；无需人工标注阶段或外加力传感器，就能让 VLA 的 LoRA 微调随操作阶段动态切换适应方向，轻量高效且代码开源。

papers.title: HABIT：面向人在场协作与交互环境的大规模机器人操作数据集
papers.titleEn: HABIT: Human-Aware Behavior and Interaction Training Dataset for Robot Manipulation
papers.venue: NeurIPS 2026 · Evaluations & Datasets Track Oral（已录用 / accepted）
papers.summary: 现有大规模机器人操作数据集几乎都在“无人静态桌面”采集，策略一旦进入有人活动的共享空间便缺乏避让、配合与响应指令能力。HABIT按协作者、共事者与监督者三种人机角色，采集超过1万条轨迹、160余小时、覆盖60项任务的人在场操作数据，证明人在场训练显著提升交互安全与响应能力。但采集者仅约十人且出自单一实验室，体型衣着与动作多样性仍有局限。
papers.summaryEn: Existing large-scale robot manipulation datasets are collected in human-absent workspaces, leaving policies unprepared for shared human environments. HABIT introduces over 10K episodes and 160+ hours across 60 tasks structured around three human-robot roles—Collaborator, Coworker, and Supervisor—showing substantial gains in human-aware behavior and adaptation. However, its collector pool of roughly ten people at one institution limits body-silhouette, clothing, and motion diversity.
papers.whySelected: NeurIPS 2026 Datasets & Benchmarks Oral；直击主流具身数据集忽视“人在场动态交互”的盲区，建立三角色系统化数据与评测框架。

papers.title: HeMeR：面向具身智能体的异构记忆结构化 KV 缓存复用推理框架
papers.titleEn: HeMeR: Heterogeneous Memory Reconciliation for Embodied Agents via Structured KV Reuse
papers.summary: 具身智能体决策需频繁综合陈述记忆、程序记忆与工作记忆，但相邻决策步间大量记忆内容并未变化，现有系统因记忆接口割裂及适配器切换被迫反复重算完整KV缓存。HeMeR提出分块级与适配器稳定的结构化KV对账框架，在不破坏上下文一致性的前提下选择性复用未变记忆片段的KV缓存，显著降低具身大模型端到端推理延迟。其工程收益突出，但对自定义推理后端与适配器调度耦合较紧。
papers.summaryEn: Embodied agents continuously combine declarative, procedural, and working memory across steps where much context stays unchanged, yet disjoint interfaces and adapter switching force full KV-cache recomputation. HeMeR introduces chunk-level and adapter-stable structured KV reconciliation to selectively reuse unchanged memory KV states while preserving consistency, cutting end-to-end embodied LLM inference latency. The systems gains are substantial, though integration is tightly coupled to custom inference engines and adapter scheduling.
papers.whySelected: NeurIPS 2026 Oral（2026-11-12 最新公开全文）；切中具身基础模型闭环部署的实时延迟瓶颈，解决跨记忆与切换适配器时的 KV 复用难题。

papers.title: 重金属特技：基于强化学习与Sim2Real的5吨级液压滑移装载机高动态控制
papers.titleEn: Heavy metal acrobatics: Learning dynamic control for skid-steer loaders
papers.venue: Science Robotics（Vol. 11 No. 120 · 2026-11-11 正式发表）
papers.summary: 5吨级液压滑移装载机具有强非线性延迟与极高物理试验风险，双轮立起行驶等极限动态机动此前仅少数顶级人类操作员能完成。ETH与合作团队通过系统辨识刻画液压执行器关键动力学，在仿真中结合域随机化训练强化学习策略，零样本部署至真实5吨重型装载机，稳定实现四轮起翘、双轮崎岖地形行驶与软着陆。该作将Sim2Real推向重工业液压极限，但各技能仍分开独立训练。
papers.summaryEn: Five-tonne hydraulic skid-steer loaders exhibit nonlinear delays and extreme safety risks, leaving acrobatic maneuvers to elite human operators. ETH Zurich and collaborators characterize key hydraulic actuation dynamics without a preexisting machine model, train RL policies with domain randomization in simulation, and deploy them zero-shot on a full-size 5-tonne loader for wheelies, rough-terrain two-wheel driving, and soft landings. It pushes Sim2Real to heavy industrial hydraulics, though skills are trained individually rather than unified.
papers.whySelected: Science Robotics 2026 年 11 月 11 日最新正式发表（近30日新文）；Marco Hutter 与 Vladlen Koltun 团队在5吨重型液压工程机械上跑通极限动态 Sim2Real。

papers.title: DR-LfD：将示范分解重组为基元与视觉运动策略的 TAMP 门控双臂长时程操作
papers.titleEn: Decompose and Reorganize: Planning with Primitives and Visuomotor Policies Learned from Demonstrations
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Robotics（T-RO 2026 · 正式录用/在线发表）
papers.summary: 传统任务与运动规划（TAMP）擅长符号长时程推理却在接触密集段脆弱，端到端模仿学习擅长局部视觉接触反馈却难泛化至多阶段重排。DR-LfD基于接触感知场景图，将人类双臂示范自动拆解为物体中心运动基元与视觉运动局部策略，再封装为TAMP流算子实现跨空间布局的重组规划。该混合架构兼顾可解释规划与局部灵巧，但上游接触场景图分割与符号定义仍具工程依赖。
papers.summaryEn: Classical TAMP excels at symbolic long-horizon planning yet is brittle in contact-rich segments, whereas imitation learning handles visual contact feedback but struggles with spatial and multi-stage generalization. DR-LfD uses contact-aware scene graphs to decompose bimanual demonstrations into object-centric primitives and local visuomotor policies, integrating them as streams inside a TAMP-gated planner for compositional reorganization. While combining interpretability and dexterity, it relies on accurate contact-graph segmentation.
papers.whySelected: IEEE T-RO 2026 最新上线（DOI 2026-11-19 注册）；清晰示范如何把端到端视觉运动策略无缝嵌入经典 TAMP 规划器以攻克双臂长时程操作。

将学习技能封装为 TAMP 流仍需要预定义一定的符号谓词与规划领域描述。 / Integrating learned skills as TAMP streams still requires structured symbolic predicates and domain specifications.

papers.title: BLIP：面向大语言模型数据处理的即插即用可验证溯源框架
papers.titleEn: Bolt-on, Verifiable Provenance for LLM-Powered Data Processing
papers.venue: PVLDB Vol. 19 No. 11（2026-09-04 在线发表）
papers.summary: 用大语言模型处理非结构化文档查询时，直接让模型“给引用”或算向量相似度并无正确性保证。BLIP提出面向LLM数据处理的可验证最小溯源定义：寻找一段极小输入文本子集，将其单独送入LLM仍能复现与全文等价的答案，并结合KV缓存成本模型设计剪枝与精炼两阶段算法，支持Top-1与Top-k溯源。它把数据库经典最小见证思想成功迁移至黑盒LLM，但受模型非确定性与单调性偏差制约。
papers.summaryEn: When LLMs answer queries over unstructured data, prompting for citations or embedding similarity offers no guarantee that the cited span actually yields the answer. BLIP defines verifiable minimal provenance as a minimal input subset that reproduces an equivalent LLM answer, pairing a KV-cache cost model with two-phase pruning and refinement for top-1 and top-k provenance. It brings classic minimal-witness provenance to black-box LLMs, though non-determinism and monotonicity violations remain practical caveats.
papers.whySelected: PVLDB 2026 第 11 期核心系统长文；UC Berkeley 数据库团队把经典的“最小可复现见证”溯源理论严谨落地到 LLM 数据处理管线，代码公开。

li.whyRead: 必读前沿交汇：看经典 why-provenance / minimal witness 思想如何在非单调、黑盒且高推理成本的 LLM 查询中重构。
li.relation: 直接拓展 provenance 与 witness minimization 至语义/非结构化数据处理系统，呼应 11/16 ProvSQL-LLM 线。
prerequisites: 数据库溯源与最小见证 / Provenance and minimal witnesses
LLM 推理与 KV 缓存 / LLM KV-cache basics

limits: 算法剪枝效率与完备性依赖强/弱单调性假设，当 LLM 面对上下文截断出现非单调推理反转时可能需要额外验证开销。 / Pruning efficiency and guarantees rely on monotonicity assumptions that can fail under non-monotonic LLM context sensitivity.
相比纯关系代数溯源，反复调用模型验证子集仍受限于答案等价判定准确度与采样随机性。 / Repeated LLM verification still depends on answer-equivalence checking and decoding determinism.
assumptions: LLM 解码可通过固定种子或等价判别器近似确定性，且支持利用前缀 KV 缓存复用降低子集重评估成本。 / Assumes near-deterministic decoding or equivalence checking and KV-cache reuse for subset re-evaluation.
